title: Earthy Polish Stuffed Vegetable
description: A hearty vegetable stuffed with a polish pilaf, a perfect comfort food for a cozy evening.

ingredients.name: 2 large earthy vegetables (such as bell peppers or zucchinis)
ingredients.notes: any combination of vegetables works well

ingredients.name: 1/4 cup xenial cheese (such as feta or goat cheese)

instructions: Cut the tops off the vegetables and scoop out the insides, leaving a shell.
In a bowl, mix together the pilaf, xenial cheese, and a pinch of salt and pepper.
Stuff each vegetable with the pilaf mixture, dividing it evenly.
Drizzle the olive oil over the vegetables and place them in a baking dish.
Cover the dish with aluminum foil and bake for 25 minutes.
Remove the foil and continue baking for an additional 10-15 minutes, or until the vegetables are tender.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
